verdicts.reason: The deletion of 'without polish' does not remove a meaningful semantic constraint but rather eliminates the specification of the nail appearance state. The source text 'Make the nails in the photo look natural without polish' specifies a single compound goal. Removing 'without polish' leaves 'Make the nails in the photo look natural,' which is semantically weaker but changes the core instruction from specifying unpolished natural nails to just natural nails (which could include polished natural looks). Both supplied positives show bare, unpolished nails. This deletion conflates the 'natural' appearance with 'without polish' as separate constraints when they form a unified attribute target in the source.
